verdict.rationale: Kimi documents automation-adjacent features such as scheduled tasks (定时任务), skills, plugins and agent tasks, so this axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows versioning, review/diff, or rollback of those automations. The 'multi-round modification' of agent-built webpages is an adjacent feature, not automation version control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
